version: illustrative - based on typical Philippine motor policy wording; confirm with Pioneer

rules.name: Policy in force and premium paid
rules.text: The policy must be in force on the date of loss and the premium paid. Otherwise the claim is declined.

rules.name: Prompt notice of loss
rules.text: Loss should be reported within the allowed number of days after it occurred. Late notice goes to an adjuster.

rules.name: Required documents complete
rules.text: Claim form, LTO OR/CR, driver's license, police report (collision/theft) and repair estimate must be on file.

rules.name: Authorised driver with valid license
rules.text: The driver must be an authorised driver on the policy and hold a license valid on the date of loss. Otherwise the claim is declined.

rules.name: Fast-track eligibility
rules.text: Own-damage claims at or below the limit with complete documents and no other flags can be approved without adjuster review.

rules.name: Estimate vs. typical repair cost
rules.text: Flag when the repair estimate exceeds the typical cost for this vehicle and damage type by more than the allowed percentage.

rules.name: Early claim after inception
rules.text: Flag losses occurring within the set number of days after policy inception.

rules.name: Duplicate / repeat claim
rules.text: Flag when the same plate has another claim within the lookback window.

rules.name: Repair shop concentration
rules.text: Flag when the repair shop appears on at least this many other claims in the last 12 months.

rules.name: Receipt validity and match
rules.text: If a receipt is attached it must show TIN, invoice number, date and total, and the total must match the estimate within the tolerance.
